# Top Cleaning Team

> Residential, commercial and specialty cleaning in Fort Lauderdale and across Broward County, Florida. Requests are made online and the price is confirmed before the visit.

Top Cleaning Team provides house cleaning, deep cleaning, move in and move out cleaning, Airbnb turnover cleaning, commercial cleaning, post construction cleaning, handyman services and after party cleaning in Fort Lauderdale and Broward County, FL.

This file describes only what the website itself states. For anything not listed here, the website is the source of truth: https://www.topcleaningteam.com

## Services

- [Residential Cleaning](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services/residential): House cleaning in Fort Lauderdale and Broward County.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services/deep-cleaning): Baseboards, interior windows, heavy stovetop scrub and intensive bathroom work. Suited to a first visit.
- [Move In / Move Out Cleaning](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services/move-in-out): Interior of appliances, cabinets and garage, for handovers and deposit returns.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services/commercial): Office and business cleaning with flexible scheduling.
- [AirBnB Turnover Cleaning](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services/airbnb): Vacation rental turnovers with fresh linens, restocking, damage inspection and photos after every clean.
- [Post Construction Cleaning](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services/post-construction): Drywall dust, paint splatter, fixture polishing and window detail after renovations.
- [Handyman Services](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services/handyman): TV mounting, furniture assembly, drywall and door repairs, painting touch-ups.
- [After Party Cleaning](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services/after-party-cleaning): Home party cleanup, booked by the hour with published rates.
- [All services](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/services): Overview of every service.

## Service Area

Fort Lauderdale and Broward County, Florida.

- [Request a cleaning online](https://www.topcleaningteam.com/booking): Choose a service, add details and request a date. The final price is confirmed before the visit.
